title: Cambium offers synthetic personas for market research
summary: Cambium's Chat with Personas lets teams ask synthetic personas, built from public data, about prices, messages and product ideas; Cambium reports no measured gain in research.
account: Cambium announced Chat with Personas in a company post dated 8 January 2026. The tool generates personas for segments of a population from public datasets. Users can ask the personas questions about prices, messages, and product features. The company reports early beta use. It provides no evaluation by a named customer and no measured improvement in research quality. In a guide published on 23 September 2025, Cambium advises users to confirm simulated feedback through real customer interviews. The feature is a documented product capability with intended research benefits. No source shows that its synthetic respondents accurately predict customer behavior. On 15 June 2026 Cambium added audience groups and group polling to the persona feature. It reported no customer results. In a study published on 17 May 2024, Vanderbilt political scientists found that ChatGPT personas matched average answers in the American National Election Studies. They also found that the synthetic answers varied too little and that regressions on those answers often differed from regressions on real respondents.
